newsitem.title: POLAND: IB Austria to underwrite Animex issue.
newsitem.headline: IB Austria to underwrite Animex issue.

text.p: Warsaw's IB Austria Securities and Investmentbank Austria AG have signed a contract with food trader and producer Animex to guarantee the latter's planned 10-million share issue, Animex's head said.

"With these entities we signed a contract on managing the issue with an appendix contract on guaranteeing the issue. It covers the whole pool of 10 million shares," Witold Pereta told Reuters on Wednesday.
Pereta said the firm had submitted a prospectus for the issue to the Polish Securties Commission (KPW).
The contract ensures that both IB Austria Securities and Investmentbank Austria will serve as lead managers of the issue, abroad as well.
It plans to use funds from the issue for investment in food sector firms in 1997-2000.
